title: Transport of a localized derived tensor model through a shifted complex isomorphism
statement: Let R,A,B,C be commutative rings in one universe, A and B R-algebras and C an algebra over E=A tensor_R B, with derived categories of R- and B-modules. Models and their maps are those of [def-pc-base-derived-tensor-cohomology-model]. For A-complexes K,L, integers n,i, an A-linear complex isomorphism e:L to K[-n], and a model mK of K, let F be termwise extension from A to C. Let eH:H^(i+n)(F(L)) to H^i(F(K)) be the prescribed isomorphism obtained by applying F to e, then the canonical scalar-extension shift isomorphism, then the cohomology reindexing -n+(i+n)=i. There exist a model mL of L and a C-linear isomorphism eS:C tensor_E mL.cohomology(i+n) to C tensor_E mK.cohomology(i) such that mK.localizedComparison(i)=eS^(-1) then mL.localizedComparison(i+n) then eH. No tensor decomposition of K and no further target complex or comparison map t is assumed.

source.place: Tags 06Y6 and 08IB; integer shifts as in Tag 0DJA(1)

proof.text: Apply the ordinary-shift-model transport theorem to obtain mL, an E-cohomology isomorphism eT and its ordinary comparison square. Define eS by applying extension E→C to eT.

Apply the coefficient shift homology theorem to mK.ordinaryToLocalized and mL.ordinaryToLocalized with their two generator formulas. This gives the square for the homology of the coefficient maps followed by restriction/homology and the prescribed eH.

The extension/restriction adjunction hom equivalence is injective. Naturality on its source and target and the two models localized_eq equations identify the desired forward square with the ordinary comparison square composed with the coefficient square. Rewrite those squares and reassociate to prove eS.hom followed by mK.localizedComparison = mL.localizedComparison followed by eH.hom. Precompose by eS.inv and cancel eS.inv followed by eS.hom to get the original statement.

proof_origin.place: Tags 06Y6, 08IB, 0DJA(1): ordinary derived-model transport, a fully proved coefficient shift square, and explicit adjunction assembly; one strict remaining intermediate theorem

lean.statement:
theorem exists_shift_square_data
    (K L : CochainComplex (ModuleCat.{u} A) ℤ) (n : ℤ) (e : L ≅ K⟦-n⟧)
    (mK : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B K C) (i : ℤ) :
    let F := (extendScalars.{u, u, u}
      ((algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C).comp (algebraMap A (A ⊗[R] B)))).mapHomologicalComplex
        (.up ℤ)
    let eH := (HomologicalComplex.homologyFunctor (ModuleCat.{u} C) (.up ℤ) (i + n)).mapIso
      (F.mapIso e ≪≫ (F.commShiftIso (-n)).app K) ≪≫
      (CochainComplex.ShiftSequence.shiftIso (ModuleCat.{u} C) (-n) (i + n) i
        (by omega)).app (F.obj K)
    ∃ (mL : BaseDerivedTensorCohomologyModel R A B L C)
      (eS : (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj (mL.cohomology (i + n)) ≅
        (extendScalars (algebraMap (A ⊗[R] B) C)).obj (mK.cohomology i)),
    mK.localizedComparison i = eS.inv ≫ mL.localizedComparison (i + n) ≫ eH.hom
